At Galveston Slingshot & Car Rentals, we don’t just rent vehicles-we rent fun! As Galveston #1 Slingshot rental company, we take pride in delivering a top-tier experience with the newest models, unbeatable service, and a commitment to

includes: Full tank of gas (premium for Slingshots, regular for Jeeps)
GPS trackers and engine disablers on all vehicles
Liability, comprehensive & collision insurance coverage included with damage deductible

blurb: Guests rent Polaris Slingshots or Jeeps to drive within specified boundaries including Galveston County, Bolivar Peninsula, Surfside Beach, and Freeport. quotes.author: Monica Ford
quotes.text: Omg!!! Where do I start?!? The slingshot experience was amazing. If I would hit the 5 stars again I would. Thank you Billy and I’d especially like to thank Kyle. Kyle went above and beyond in making our experience a memorable one. The process was explained in detail and we had no problems. Whenever I’m back in town I will most definitely be coming here. I promise to send everyone I know you guys way.

quotes.author: Bryan Sims
quotes.text: Man it was my wife’s birthday and they absolutely took care of us had to reschedule for a later time. No Problem!!! Demetrius was professional and made sure we were fully accommodated!!! If you ever want to rent vehicles for a good time at a good price from good people this is the place to go!!!!

quotes.author: joey clement
quotes.text: Me and my mom went here on Friday January 24th during the off season and enjoyed the experience of renting a slingshot! Definitely good customer service explained everything appropriately through himself and a video. Would recommend to others to enjoy this experience!!

quotes.author: Tim Enright
quotes.text: Fun way to see the area. This was a gift for my wife and she loved it. Don't be thrown off by the video the owner requires you to watch stating all the costs for damages you can be responsible for. Or by the non-refundable deposit they have. It is still alot of fun.
